easyPrerequisites: Pest Friend must have valid targets.
description:
Cast Pest Friend using the convoke ability from Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia by tapping Lluwen, Exchange Student.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Lluwen, Exchange Student, which enters prepared.
Resolve Pest Friend.
Repeat.
